pr_title: feat: worker emit fileName with config
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing! -->

### Description

fix: #7613
fix: #7928
fix: #8089

<!-- Please insert your description here and provide especially info about the "what" this PR is solving -->

### Additional context

* [this.getFilename](https://github.com/rollup/rollup/blob/030c56fd6b186a0ddfd57d143ad703f34fd2c17a/src/utils/FileEmitter.ts#L200-L207) will got a `emitFile` chunk’s fileName. So we can use this chunk’s fileName directly.
* we emit file with the other chunk fileName and the fileName is exist, Rollup will [call warning](https://github.com/rollup/rollup/blob/030c56fd6b186a0ddfd57d143ad703f34fd2c17a/src/utils/FileEmitter.ts#L230-L248). And we just need to don't modify fileName, the warning will not be called. we can use the `entryFileNames, chunkFileNames, assetFileNames` make the file into truth path.
* Rollup will make the same emitFile [unique](https://github.com/rollup/rollup/blob/030c56fd6b186a0ddfd57d143ad703f34fd2c17a/src/utils/renderNamePattern.ts#L33-L43), we need to avoid call `emitFile` with same filename.
* I found that the sourcemap file name in other places is named after the file name of the original file plus the map. Take the same plan in worker sourcemap.

comments: whoa, super weird. i've updated the project and it should be showing up now. thanks!
were you able to repro @famoser ? thanks! https://stackblitz.com/edit/vitejs-vite-wywvny?file=vite.config.js

You can use `worker.rollupOptions.output.assetFileNames` to configure this. I wonder if it's safe to inherit the rollup options from `build.rollupOptions` though, seems like it could be confusing if we start to merge them (and potentially conflicting).

@tarngerine I have a similar problem that assetFileNames is not applied in all (by myself) expected cases, but not exactly the same. As soon as I have a clean repro I'll probably create a new issue to avoid highjacking this one.

> You can use `worker.rollupOptions.output.assetFileNames` to configure this.

You mean like this: https://stackblitz.com/edit/vitejs-vite-p9bztw?file=vite.config.js
Because then it still appends the hash, seemingly ignoring the `worker.rollupOptions.output` config.

I've looked into this a while now; there seem to be multiple issues like this.

Similar problems are unresolved with the legacy plugin: See https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/4628 and https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/6923. In at least one special case, specifically defining the naming of the `polyfills-legacy.[hash].js` file, the functionality is simply not implemented yet: The rollupOptions are not passed to build invoked in the legacy plugin: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/7ddbf96ae11bf0eeef97ffc00dcf5ac4c561cc20/packages/plugin-legacy/index.js#L592 

In a local project of mine, without the legacy plugin & very similar config as the initial repro of this issue, the configuration option in `rollupOptions.output.assetFileNames` is respected (including for workers). I have not found an explanation for this so far.
